summary: Mutation tests verify that changing any v2 API signature, version, method set, or signal set causes a test failure. Each mutation guard test asserts exact counts and signatures.

guards: SetPamServiceEnabled in args (s, b) out arg b
mutation_tests.mutation: Change ListPamServices out type from a(ssbss) to a(ssbbb)
Change ProtectionStatusChanged arg type from (sbs) to (sbb)
Add or remove a v2 method from the XML
Add or remove a v2 signal from the XML
Rename a v2 method (e.g. ListPamServices -> GetPamServices)
Change a struct field type (e.g. enabled: bool -> u32)

guards: v1 interface block byte-for-byte in v2 XML
mutation_tests.mutation: Modify the v1 interface section inside the v2 XML

guards: no forbidden token in v2 XML (case-insensitive)
mutation_tests.mutation: Add a forbidden token (e.g. 'template') to v2 XML

guards: no forbidden token in serialized v2 types
mutation_tests.mutation: Add a field containing a forbidden token name
Change negotiate_version_v2 to accept any version

verdict: All mutation tests would fail on the described mutations, confirming the v2 contract is frozen.
